title: Complication / twist
_note: Phase 9.4 Complication oracle: a terse, system-agnostic setback to drop into a "yes, but…" / "no, and…" beat or to spice a quiet scene. Reads as a GM prompt, never a stat block — the ruling is yours. Full sentences with their own terminal punctuation. All weight 1 — a flat draw. Retune/extend freely.
